patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Coralogix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Coralogix's shape. Choose Coralogix only if your buying job matches “Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage differs because AppDynamics is shaped for Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium ( whereas Coralogix is shaped for Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metric. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Coralogix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Coralogix is Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50/1M tokens; 14-day / 8-unit trial. No seat floor. .
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs Coralogix (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Coralogix — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6).

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Coralogix: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Coralogix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Coralogix's motion (Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
